title: Finite-cutoff Gibbs integrability and positive-mass branch conditioning
question: Does the unchanged hash-pinned A1 reference functional define a finite-cutoff Gibbs law, and what conditioning rule is valid for the R-461/R-463 branch geometry?
purpose: Supply the finite-measure prerequisite named by R-463 without replacing the established A6, T-054, T-059, or T-061 methods. Separate exact null-branch geometry from positive-mass tube conditioning.

exact_scope.domain: finite spectral Galerkin space with m=(2N+1)^3 sites and six real coordinates per site
exact_scope.functional: hash-pinned A1 standalone reference functional with eta_shell=0, positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers
exact_scope.quadratic_floor: K(k)>=mu2=r-Z^2/(4Y)>0; family, lock and Class-II quadratic terms are nonnegative
exact_scope.coercive_bound: p(t)>=gamma*t^3/12-C for t>=0, T=3*ell/gamma and C=ell*T^2/4
exact_scope.gibbs_status: finite-dimensional Lebesgue integral is finite for every beta>0 at fixed N
exact_scope.branch_rule: mu_N(A|B)=mu_N(A intersect B)/mu_N(B) only when mu_N(B)>0
exact_scope.pure_singlet: first two complex components zero at every site; real codimension 4*m and zero Lebesgue mass
exact_scope.active_branch: no zero-mass assertion; a positive-mass tube remains an owner input
exact_scope.limit_order: none; fixed-cutoff integrability and conditioning prerequisite only

theorem.finite_normalizability: The sextic comparison and finite-dimensional radial integrability imply 0<Z_N(beta)<infinity for every fixed cutoff N and beta>0.
theorem.conditioning: Exact zero-mass branches cannot be conditioned by division; positive-mass branch tubes have the usual normalized conditional measure.
theorem.uniformity_boundary: The coercive coefficient gamma*V/(12*m^3) depends on m and supplies no cutoff-uniform bound.

proof_skeleton: Read the A1 parameters as exact decimal rationals and derive mu2, ell, T, and C.
Use the two algebraic branches t>=T and 0<=t<=T to prove the cubic lower bound.
Apply the finite-site power-mean inequality to obtain a degree-six norm coercivity bound.
Invoke the standard finite-dimensional radial exp(-a*||z||^6) integral comparison.
Compute the pure-singlet codimension and state the positive-mass tube conditioning identity without assigning branch probability.
Run independent, hostile, integrated, and Lean checks while leaving entropy, tightness, and all limits open.
assumptions: The hash-pinned A1 standalone reference functional is the controlling finite-cutoff static functional.
The finite spectral Galerkin space is finite-dimensional and carries Lebesgue reference measure.
Y>0, mu2>0, gamma>0, lambda<=0, nonnegative family/lock terms, and positive Class-II coefficient matrix hold in the pinned manifest.
The standard radial integrability formula for exp(-a*||z||^6) is available in finite real dimension.
Branch tubes are measurable sets whose positive mass must be supplied by a later owner packet.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned R-461/R-463 branch map and a positive-mass tube at each cutoff.
A quantitative correlated-Gibbs tube probability and phase/singlet entropy or Jacobian estimate.
Cutoff- and volume-uniform partition estimates, tightness, subsequential bare-measure classification, and floor removal.
A source-owned Q3LOCK production dynamics, common alpha, physical-empty comparison, QFT/Yang--Mills identity, or mass-gap bridge.

adversarial_review.check: Could a negative quadratic symbol invalidate the radial lower bound?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: Y and the exact A1-computed mu2 are checked positive.

adversarial_review.check: Could the negative quartic term overwhelm the sextic term?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the threshold T=3*ell/gamma and two exact branches give the displayed bound.

adversarial_review.check: Could the degree-six finite bound be called cutoff-uniform?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: its coefficient scales as m^-3 and uniformity remains open.

adversarial_review.check: Can a codimension-positive pure-singlet branch receive a conditional law by division?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: it has zero Lebesgue mass; a positive-mass tube is required.

adversarial_review.check: Does the same zero-mass conclusion automatically hold for the active null branch?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: no active-branch mass assertion is made.

adversarial_review.check: Could this finite integral replace the correlated full-field Gibbs law or the R-463 proxy?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: it is only a fixed-cutoff prerequisite and uses no conditional-mean substitution.

adversarial_review.check: Does the finite integrability lemma replace T-054 or alter T-059/T-061?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive prerequisite with unchanged owner order and methods.

adversarial_review.check: Can finite normalisability select a physical-empty or Reading-H branch?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: no physical branch, stationarity, QFT, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap field is introduced.

audit.finite_coordinate_convention: six real coordinates per complex three-component site
audit.branch_tube_rule: positive mass required; exact pure-singlet mass is zero

evidence_level: T0 exact fixed-cutoff finite-dimensional Gibbs integrability and positive-mass conditioning prerequisite; not a concentration, tightness, or continuum theorem
non_claims: This result does not compute a branch or tube probability.
It does not assign a conditional measure to an exact zero-mass null branch.
It does not provide a cutoff- or volume-uniform partition estimate, entropy density, or tightness.
It does not remove the rho floor, select Reading-H or a physical-empty branch, or close A6/A7.
It does not prove Pre-A, Sector A, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum, or mass gap.
The established T-054, T-059, and T-061 methods, owner order, and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
boundary: R-464 proves only fixed-cutoff finite-dimensional integrability and the admissible conditioning rule. It does not provide a branch tube, a probability estimate, entropy control, uniformity, tightness, a limit, or physical identification.
next_action: Obtain a source-owned positive-mass branch tube and quantitative correlated-Gibbs probability estimate; then feed R-463's metric into that estimate while keeping exact null branches unconditioned. In parallel continue the unchanged T-054 Q3LOCK owner intake and T-059/T-061 observation locks.
